summary: Supporting engineering review for 61-frame (2.1s) excerpt with dots-v1 stippling. All 6 hard gates pass decisively: persistent stage, camera motion, bottom captions, readability, zero collisions, and precise audio-visual sync on 'catches' at frame 260. The excerpt cannot fulfill full-film storyline or beat pacing rubrics due to its 2.1s duration, leading to a REVISE verdict for the excerpt scope while confirming robust shader and rig performance.

facts.rawSummaryText:
SCOPE: This is a 61-frame engineering excerpt, absolute source frames 230-290 at 30 fps (source 7.6667-9.6667 s), from the approved 51.15-second message-receipt film. Contact is source frame 260, clip time 1.0 s. Only stage shading changed to dots-v1; characters, rigs, actions, camera, captions and scenery are the same. Source stage facts below describe the full authored source timeline, NOT events all visible in this two-second clip. Do not infer full-film storyline, pacing, complete narration, or acceptance from this excerpt. Give an honest supporting review of visible face/hand/prop readability, dot stability and occlusion. The ordinary full-film rubric may fail on this limited clip. This review is supporting engineering evidence only. Use ordinary hyphens throughout the report.

=== PRE-MEASURED GROUND TRUTH FACTS (DETERMINISTIC FACTS) ===
- Exact Video Duration: 2.1s (do NOT hallucinate a different duration such as 120s)
- Dimensions: 1080x1920
=== STAGE FACTS FOR THIS OUTPUT (projected geometry and action data; pixels and craft unmeasured) ===
- Stage: one persistent Three.js stage, seen in the reel output (1080x1920).
- Treatment (captions excluded): beat-01: iona=dots-v1, glider=dots-v1; beat-02: iona=dots-v1, glider=dots-v1; beat-03: iona=dots-v1, glider=dots-v1; beat-04: iona=dots-v1, glider=dots-v1; beat-05: iona=dots-v1, glider=dots-v1; beat-06: iona=dots-v1, glider=dots-v1; beat-07: iona=dots-v1, glider=dots-v1.
- Characters drawn: 1: Iona (cast "iona", character iona v1, rig iona-v1, hash ab657d689f18). Props drawn: glider. Cast never drawn (hidden): none.
- Performance receive-message: iona (iona v1) catches glider; the decisive word "catches" (start) in shot beat-02 is at 8.67 s (frame 260); contact at frame 260, on the word. Ownership: start airborne, held by no character, contact attached, held by cast "iona", after-state attached, held by cast "iona". Projected in frame at contact: iona, glider. Afterwards: holding the message.
- Projected in frame per shot (posed geometry in this output, not pixels): beat-01 0-8.03 s: start iona, glider, end iona, glider; beat-02 8.03-14.67 s: start iona, glider, end iona, glider; beat-03 14.67-21.93 s: start iona, glider, end iona, glider; beat-04 21.93-28.75 s: start iona, glider, end iona, glider; beat-05 28.75-35.29 s: start iona, glider, end iona, glider; beat-06 35.29-43.3 s: start iona, glider, end iona, glider; beat-07 43.3-51.15 s: start iona, glider, end iona, glider.
- Camera: 4 move(s) in the reel output, fastest 7% of the output width per second. A moving character or prop is not a camera move.
- NOT measured by any tool: pixel visibility and final occlusion (foreground artwork or another mesh may hide a projected character); face appeal and expression readability; finger contact with the prop; silhouette strength and apparent weight. Judge these only from what you see and hear in the video. If you cannot see it clearly, it does not pass: never credit a criterion from these facts alone.
- Audio Mix: -15.2 LUFS (target -18 to -14), peak -1.0 dBFS (PASS)
- Bottom Captions: Burned-in bottom captions detected in 100% of sampled frames (12/12) -> Gate Status: PASS
- Camera Motion: 4 camera moves in the reel output, measured from the compiled stage camera projected into this crop (meets requirement of >= 1) -> Gate Status: PASS
MANDATORY EVALUATION INSTRUCTIONS FOR GEMINI:
1. The deterministic facts above are verified ground-truth measurements. You MUST NOT contradict these facts.
2. Bottom Captions Gate: If the measured fact indicates 0% captions or FAIL, you MUST set isGate=true, passed=false, score=0.0 for "bottom_captions". Do NOT pass captions when 0% are present.
3. Camera Gate: If camera motion is verified present above, do not claim the camera is static or award 0/10. Evaluate its framing purpose.
4. Duration and Pacing: Base all pacing and duration comments on the exact measured duration (2.1s).
5. Stage: the stage facts say where geometry and contacts are, not what the pixels show. A character or prop counts only if you can see it in the video. Face appeal, finger contact and occlusion are unmeasured: judge them from the video, and never pass a criterion on these facts alone.
